Merge in THIS order into `integration/nexis-wave12`:
1. `origin/feature/booking-hours-upsell`  (JSON policies; touches settings/page.tsx, schedule/page.tsx, api/settings/route.ts)
2. `origin/feature/roles`  (JSON policies; touches settings/page.tsx, sidebar, access.ts, middleware, +32 route handlers, api/team/roles)
3. `origin/feature/email-templates`  (JSON policies; touches settings/page.tsx, api/settings/route.ts, mailer.ts, send paths, media/upload)
4. `origin/feature/gift-cards`  (ADDITIVE Prisma models GiftCard+GiftCardTxn; touches schema.prisma, checkout, pos, sidebar, nav, access.ts + new files)

## Conflict resolution principle: UNION, keep everything
The conflicts are additive and non-antagonistic — resolve by KEEPING ALL additions from every branch:
- **`src/app/(admin)/settings/page.tsx`**: must end up with ALL new tabs/sections — Opening hours + Upsell preview (booking branch), Roles tab (roles branch), Email Templates tab (email branch). Don't drop any.
- **`src/app/api/settings/route.ts`**: keep ALL new sections (hours, emailtpl, and any others). Each branch's handler block must survive.
- **sidebar / nav**: keep the gift-cards link AND the roles capability-based hiding.
- **`src/lib/access.ts`**: keep BOTH the gift-cards INSTRUCTOR-deny AND the roles legacy-mapping.
- Any other conflict: integrate both intents; never delete one branch's feature to satisfy another.
After resolving, sanity-check that each feature's key files are all present and coherent.

## Verify
`npx tsc --noEmit` MUST be clean (exit 0) and `npm run build` MUST pass (exit 0) in the worktree. If the build surfaces a real integration bug (not a pre-existing issue), fix it minimally and note it. Do NOT run `prisma db push` against any live DB (schema change is additive; it's applied at deploy time).

## Finish
- Commit the integration merge and push `integration/nexis-wave12` to origin.
- Do NOT merge to main, do NOT deploy, do NOT restart services.
- Remove the worktree when done: `git -C /opt/nexis worktree remove /opt/nexis-wt-integ --force`. Also remove the earlier per-feature worktrees if they still exist (/opt/nexis-wt-booking, -giftcard, -roles, -email). Clean up any helper scripts on /opt/nxeon.
